defect.layer: transcripts/wer_tags sidecar against the .nlp wer_tags column
defect.origin: an annotation gap in the Earnings-21 release itself, not a defect of this repository and not fixable from here

regression_anchor.source: SAEA-E-005B-N10-zero sealed outputs, attempt-20260814T235515Z-044ccc, the ten frozen discovery calls
regression_anchor.why_it_must_be_identical: none of the ten calls references an absent entity id, so the new branch is never taken for them and the number cannot move

repair.rule: an entity id the sidecar LISTS but does not usably label stays fatal (a corrupt annotation); an entity id the sidecar does not list AT ALL is labelled __UNTYPED__ and counted, so it appears as its own row with its own gold-mention count in every by_entity_type table the scorer produces
repair.why_not_a_weakening: the guarantee the old refusal protected was that a mention whose class the corpus never recorded is never GIVEN one; the sentinel keeps that guarantee exactly and drops only the blast radius, which was one missing token annotation refusing all four scorers on a sealed 44-call run

what_this_is: the scope and the regression anchor for the data.references repair that let SAEA-E21-FULL44-DIRECT-BASELINE-V2 finalize. The V2 flight COMPLETED all 1593 windows and then could not be scored at all: core.scorers.score_bundle runs a manifest's whole scorer list, and entity-wer refused on one missing annotation.
zero_contact: no model, GPU, llama-server, tool, embedding, network or audio-decode contact; a structural scan of the corpus annotation layers plus one re-score of an already-published sealed read
